title: Personal Banker
summary: Open accounts, sit with people through the hard conversations about money, and know when to escalate rather than improvise.

title: Payments Operations Analyst
summary: Review and release outgoing wires and ACH files, and hold the ones that should not go.

title: Fraud Investigator
summary: Work claims end to end: the customer call, the evidence, the provisional credit and the decision.

title: BSA / AML Officer
summary: Own the sanctions and monitoring programme, and be the person who can say no to the business.

title: Core Platform Engineer
summary: Build the ledger, the alerting and the interfaces the rest of the bank runs on. Correctness first, always.

title: Commercial Relationship Manager
summary: Carry a book of operating businesses and know their cash cycle better than their bookkeeper does.

title: Credit Underwriter
summary: Underwrite consumer and small business credit, and write decisions a customer can actually read.
